welcomeMessage: Welcome to Calvary Chapel Antelope Valley! We are glad you are here. Whether you are joining us in person or online, may God bless you today.

announcements.title: VBS Volunteer Registration
announcements.body: Come out and serve on July 19th - 23rd from 5 PM - 9 PM for VBS. We will need lots of volunteers to help so please fill out the volunteer registration form at the table in the courtyard.

announcements.title: VBS Volunteer Meeting
announcements.body: VBS Volunteers! We will be having a meeting on Sunday July 12th after 2nd service in the 4th and 5th grade classroom.

announcements.title: VBS Set Up
announcements.body: VBS set up is starting Friday July 17th at 12 noon. We will need lots of help to set up everything so please sign up in the foyer.

announcements.title: Grounds For Grace High School Bible Study
announcements.body: Come and join us at Amate Coffee from 6 PM - 8 PM on July 17th  to fill your cup with coffe and your heart with truth. More information and sign up in the foyer.

announcements.title: Men's Breakfast
announcements.body: Come join us for the men’s breakfast Saturday July 18th from 8 AM - 10 AM. There will be food, fellowship and Pastor Fabian Moreno from CC Santa Paula will be bringing the Word. Sign up in the foyer.

announcements.title: Baptism
announcements.body: Come join us August 2nd after second service for food, fellowship and to celebrate with those publicly declaring their faith in Jesus through baptism. Please sign up in the foyer if you want to be baptized.
